nodes.description: Public mapping address=>uint of token balances; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint allowances; decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Privileged deployer address; used as whitelist bypass in ensure() and as the gate for admin functions.
uint _saleNum limiting number of sells per address, read by condition() and written by init().
uint _minSale minimum sell amount enforced by condition().
uint _maxSale maximum sell amount enforced by condition().
mapping address=>uint counting sells per address; incremented unchecked in transferFrom.
mapping address=>bool whitelist that bypasses condition() inside ensure().
address tradeAddress whitelisted in ensure(); written by owner via setTradeAddress.
Public total supply assigned in the constructor with unchecked multiplication.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public constant decimals = 18 used in supply arithmetic.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure().
public payable transfer(address _to,uint _value) that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
public payable transferFrom; checks allowance, calls ensure(), then updates balances, _onSaleNum and emits Transfer using unchecked arithmetic.
public payable approve(address _spender,uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
internal view whitelist gate allowing owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale senders, otherwise delegating to condition().
internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and per-address sale-count limits.
public payable delegate(address a,bytes b) performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address when invoked by owner.
owner-only init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) configuring the sale limits.
owner-only batchSend distributing _value to each address in _tos with unchecked multiplication and duplicated Transfer events.
owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist address.
internal pure pairFor computing the Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 keccak hash.
constructor setting name/symbol/supply, owner=msg.sender, full balance and infinite allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender: external caller identity used for authorization, allowance ownership and transfer authorisation.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary external code within the token's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath (underflow risk).
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath (overflow risk).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ unchecked counter increment.
uint total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) unchecked multiplication in the constructor.
_to recipient address parameter of transfer().
_value amount parameter of transfer().
_from source address parameter of transferFrom().
_to recipient address parameter of transferFrom().
_value amount parameter of transferFrom().
_spender address parameter of approve().
_value amount parameter of approve().
a target address of the delegatecall in delegate().
b calldata blob passed to delegatecall in delegate().
saleNum sale-count limit parameter of init().
token minimum sale amount parameter of init().
maxToken maximum sale amount parameter of init().
_tos recipient address array parameter of batchSend().
_value per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend().
addr new trade address parameter of setTradeAddress().
_from sender address parameter of ensure().
_to recipient address parameter of ensure().
_value amount parameter of ensure().
_from sender address parameter of condition().
_value amount parameter of condition().
_UNI computed Uniswap pair address local of ensure().
total = _value * _tos.length local of batchSend().
_to loop recipient local inside batchSend().
i loop index local inside batchSend().

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorise the spender in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve and emitted in Approval.
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) before performing delegatecall.
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and credits the full supply to msg.sender.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the implicit _from when forwarding to transferFrom.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving balances.
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair whitelist address.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
transferFrom adds _value to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom subtracts _value from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] unchecked.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries with unchecked subtraction and addition.
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) without overflow protection.
decimals is read to scale the initial supply.
totalSupply state variable is assigned by the unchecked supply multiplication.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI router] = uint(-1).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
balanceOf is read and written by transferFrom.
allowance is read and decremented by transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
owner address is whitelisted and bypasses condition() inside ensure().
owner identity is the only authorization for the delegatecall in delegate().
ensure reads canSale[_from] to whitelist a sender.
ensure reads tradeAddress for whitelist comparison.
ensure reads the constant UNI router address for whitelist comparison.
condition reads _saleNum to decide whether sale limits apply.
condition reads _minSale to enforce the minimum sell amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum sell amount.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the per-address sale limit.
init writes _saleNum from its saleNum argument.
init writes _minSale derived from its token argument.
init writes _maxSale derived from its maxToken argument.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
delegate() passes its attacker-supplied address and data into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
arbitrary code reached through delegatecall can re-enter transferFrom before state finalisation.
_from parameter feeds allowance and balance logic in transferFrom.
_to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter determines the amounts subtracted and added in transferFrom.
_to parameter is forwarded from transfer to transferFrom.
_value parameter is forwarded from transfer to transferFrom.
_spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping by approve.
_value parameter is stored as the approved amount by approve.
address a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
bytes b is the delegatecall calldata in delegate.
saleNum parameter sets the _saleNum limit in init.
token parameter sets the _minSale limit in init.
maxToken parameter sets the _maxSale limit in init.
_tos array drives the batchSend transfer loop.
_value amounts are credited to each recipient in batchSend.
_tos.length scales the unchecked total multiplication.
_value is the multiplicand of the unchecked total computation.
addr parameter is assigned to tradeAddress.
_from parameter drives the whitelist and condition checks in ensure.
_to parameter is compared against the whitelist addresses in ensure.
_value parameter is forwarded to condition in ensure.
_from parameter indexes _onSaleNum in condition.
_value parameter is compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
